verdict.rationale: SerpApi returns search results in open formats: JSON by default, plus raw HTML or Markdown (serpapi-docs-3, serpapi-docs-38). Past results can be retrieved through its Searches Archive API (serpapi-docs-14), and plans are month-to-month with cancel-anytime terms, so leaving is unobstructed (serpapi-docs-56). However, nothing documents a bulk export of all account data such as full search history, account records or usage logs; archive retrieval appears to be per-search. missing for 10: documented bulk or complete account data export, explicit data-portability or offboarding docs, independent corroboration of export completeness.
